notes.title: Vendor Comparison — Travel Booking Platform
notes.content:
Travel Booking Platform Comparison — For Team Travel

Context: Need a solution for booking team travel (offsite, conferences, interviews). Currently doing it manually.

Option 1: Navan (formerly TripActions)
- Price: $10/user/month
- Pros: All-in-one (flights, hotels, ground), policy enforcement, expense integration
- Cons: Expensive for our size, complex setup
- Best for: Companies >25 people

Option 2: TravelPerk
- Price: Free tier available, $5/user/month for premium
- Pros: Clean UI, good inventory, flexible cancellation
- Cons: EU-focused (fewer US options), no expense integration
- Best for: European teams, budget-conscious

Option 3: Continue manual (Google Flights + Hotels.com)
- Price: Free
- Pros: Maximum flexibility, no commitment
- Cons: Time-consuming, no policy enforcement, hard to track spend
- Best for: Very small teams (<10)

Recommendation: Stay manual for now (team of 13, only ~5 trips/year). Revisit at 20+ employees. Save the $10/user/month.

Decision: Sarah agreed — stay manual. Marcus handles all bookings.

Action: Create a simple travel request form in Google Forms instead.
